searchText: > Should we then merge <@!301186049323958275>'s single txn pool PR so the EIP is up to date with the implementations? <@!552133098075193354> I already had the single tx pool so we just need to change the config line to set the transition period to 0 > I don't think we can be sure miners will make less $ after 1559; it seems to me they'll make more dollars (less Eth). <@!375471494081282048> I think the fee burning may be treated as taxes and the economical models usually say that introduction of taxes is being split between miners and users in a ratio dependent on the price elasticity. <@!273808422753796097> was calculating the elasticity to be around 2 recently so I think we can exactly calculate the percentage of the tax that will be absorbed by the miners (should be 60% or so of the top of my head?) > <@!375471494081282048> eth = more $ <@!748641831331561532> I think 1559 will surely drive the eth price up, and it's based on fundamentals so is a very safe bet. There are a _lot_ of factors that affect the price of ETH, and crypto in general. I think it's extremely risky to assume any one change will drive price up/down and IMO we can't use this as a rationale for justifying changes to the protocol. I have been in the stock market since 2007 and in crypto trading since 2015. If there are fundamental reasons for a stock to go up, it will eventually go up and technical analysis describes/predicts *how* it should get there. there are a lot of factors. but someone like warren buffet invests based on fundamentals. eth is probably one of the few crypto assets with real fundamentals behind it. but it can get better. Blockchain UX is quite terrible, we already naturally burn ETH (check the burn address) , additionally incidents like the Parity bug added to that 🙂 ...yet the price dropped 90%. I just want to voice some caution about having price related discussions in this discord. I recognize that 1559 has an economic component and that there are legitimate price related discussions to be had in relation to it, so I'm simply raising a caution flag to ensure that any price related discussion that occurs is directly related to 1559 and is a necessary thing. <@!97774605351010304> keyword is eventually. and the price fall of 90% wasn't caused based on 1 factor. bitcoin also fell a lot. > I just want to voice some caution about having price related discussions in this discord. I recognize that 1559 has an economic component and that there are legitimate price related discussions to be had in relation to it, so I'm simply raising a caution flag to ensure that any price related discussion that occurs is directly related to 1559 and is a necessary thing. <@!364458974906548225> The main objection to 1559 is from miners. I am trying to make the case that miners will make more money after 1559. This is better for <#692078615269212180> as well, this channel is for development discussion (e.g., implementation discussion). 👍 (only providing a gentle reminder for everyone in the channel to make sure we stay on topic)
